title: Love zinus mattresses but this frame is awful
text:
Love zinus mattresses but this frame is awful. Poorly designed, unnecessarily complicated set up. Get the Amazon basic frame that folds together and can be set up in a fifth of the time. For a similar or better price.

The middle legs constantly slant as well. Causing noise as well.

product_metadata.title: ZINUS Van 16 Inch Metal Platform Bed Frame / Steel Slat Support / No Box Spring Needed / Easy Assembly, King
features: PRACTICAL AND RELIABLE DESIGN - With an ultra-durable metal structure and over a foot of under bed clearance space for storing odds and ends, this metal foundation is an understated solution built for more than just great sleep
NO BOX SPRING NEEDED - Durable steel slats support and extend the life of your latex, memory foam or spring mattress without the need for a box spring
EASY ASSEMBLY - Everything you need is efficiently packed into one box and shipped straight to your door; all parts, tools and instructions are included for easy, two-person assembly in under an hour
Mattress sold separately; twin size supports a maximum weight capacity of 350 lbs, while all other sizes can support up to 700 lbs
description: The Van steel 16 inch metal platform bed by Zinus provides strong support for your memory foam, latex, or spring mattress. This platform bed is 16 inches high with clearance under the frame for valuable under bed storage. The Zinus Van metal platform bed provides reliable and durable mattress support. Mattress sold separately.
